<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- Become a Host promotional card Reuses: shape_button_blue for button Features: Orange background, call-to-action button, descriptive text --> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:background="@drawable/shape_card_orange" android:paddingHorizontal="16dp" android:paddingVertical="20dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="16dp" android:layout_marginVertical="16dp" android:gravity="center_vertical">
<!-- Create a shape drawable for rounded corners --> <!-- Using android:background with custom drawable approach -->
<!-- Title --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/become_a_host" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="18sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<!-- Description --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/become_a_host_description" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="13sp" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp" android:alpha="0.9" />
<!-- Get Started Button --> <Button android:id="@+id/become_host_button" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="40dp" android:text="@string/get_started" android:textAllCaps="false" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="#FF9800" android:textSize="13sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:paddingHorizontal="28dp" android:background="@drawable/shape_button_white_rounded" />
</LinearLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- Individual menu item for profile settings Modular component with icon, title, subtitle, and navigation arrow Used for: Notifications, Privacy & Security, Payment Methods, Reviews, Help Center --> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="56dp" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:paddingHorizontal="16dp" android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground" android:clickable="true" android:focusable="true">
<!-- Icon --> <ImageView android:id="@+id/menu_item_icon" android:layout_width="24dp" android:layout_height="24dp" android:src="@drawable/location_icon" android:contentDescription="@string/menu_item_icon" android:scaleType="fitCenter" app:tint="#757575" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" />
<!-- Title and Subtitle --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical" android:gravity="start">
<TextView android:id="@+id/menu_item_title" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/notifications" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="#212121" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/menu_item_subtitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/manage_your_notifications" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="#757575" android:textSize="12sp" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" /> </LinearLayout>
<!-- Navigation Arrow --> <ImageView android:layout_width="20dp" android:layout_height="20dp" android:src="@drawable/back_arrow" android:contentDescription="@string/navigate" android:scaleType="fitCenter" app:tint="#BDBDBD" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:rotation="180" />
</LinearLayout>

<!-- Stat Number --> <TextView android:id="@+id/stat_value" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/stat_number_placeholder" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="24sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<!-- Stat Label --> <TextView android:id="@+id/stat_label" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/bookings_label" android:fontFamily="@font/lexend" android:textColor="@android:color/white" android:textSize="12sp" android:layout_marginTop="6dp" android:gravity="center" />
</LinearLayout>
